note: A WORD LONGER THAN THE COLUMN OVERRUNS IT rather than being broken or dropped: Emacs answers "aaaaaaaaaa\nbb". kg's C fill already has this rule (`reflow_wrap' in src/word.c ends a line only when it holds more than the indent), so this is a property the binding inherits rather than one it has to add -- which is why the case is here: it is the part of `fill-region' kg does NOT have to write. kg answers `void-function' at this pin.
